question: During the reign of which of the Pallava kings was the shore temple at Mahabalipuram built?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Narasimhavarman II**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Shore Temple at Mahabalipuram was built during the reign of **Narasimhavarman II**.
 
• Mahabalipuram, also known as Mamallapuram, is famous for its group of sanctuaries carved out of rock along the Coromandel coast in the 7th and 8th centuries AD.
